copy_policy: Original run metadata, full ACP, gzip full LLM and training rows, genuine pre-verifier archives, actual post-verifier diagnostic files, original verifier output, explicit zero-model recovered scoring, complete exposed candidates, existing audit/cleanup receipts. historical_path_policy: Absolute paths and publication=false fields inside original snapshots preserve their collection-time meaning. Use this MANIFEST and relative published paths for current access.
